latin: Per uolatile quod creatum est die quinta, debemus intelligere angelos mundanos qui hominibus apparent, non eos qui non apparent nisi in spiritu.
translation: The winged creatures made on the fifth day signify the worldly angels who show themselves to men, not the ones perceived only in spirit.
